fullDescription: A skeuomorphism mobile app home screen for smart home control: a brushed metal thermostat dial with a knurled ring and an amber heating arc, pushable scene buttons, real rocker toggles, a dimmer with a knurled thumb, and a debossed energy meter, all matte eggshell plastic on a warm putty wall. Copy the tactile style for any app UI that needs controls people want to touch.
prompt:
## Resumo
A light tactile skeuomorphism SMART HOME CONTROL mobile home screen ('HAVEN'): a warm putty-stone wall (#dcd8cf) where every control is matte eggshell plastic (#f3f1ea) that looks physically pressable. A sticky raised top bar (house name + a debossed weather chip + a round embossed avatar), a room-chip row with the active chip pressed IN with an amber pilot dot, a hero brushed-aluminum rotary thermostat dial (240px) with a knurled rim, a debossed inner face, an SVG amber heating arc and a 64px temperature numeral, three embossed mode buttons (heat pressed), four three-layer pushable scene buttons (one pressed with an amber glow), a 2-column device grid of tactile cards each with a REAL rocker toggle in a debossed track (a lights card with a glowing icon well and a dimmer slider with a knurled metal thumb, a speaker card with a tiny VU meter in a debossed well, a matte off purifier card, a door card with a key plate and an ink Locked pill), a debossed energy-meter screen with mono digits and an etched bar sparkline, and a sticky raised bottom tab bar with a physical convex center FAB. Amber is the only chroma and always means ON. Frameless real screen, no phone mockup; pure CSS/SVG with all states frozen.

## Estilo Visual
Build a LIGHT tactile skeuomorphism material system. Ground: a warm putty-stone wall, linear-gradient(180deg,#dcd8cf,#d3cfc6), background-attachment fixed. Control plastic: #f3f1ea faces with edge tone #c9c5ba; ink text #2b2822, muted #7c766a, hairlines #c2beb3. ONE accent: amber #f5a11c (glow rgba(245,161,28,.45), deep #c97f0e) used ONLY for on/active states. Three shadow recipes used consistently everywhere: RAISED = inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85), inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(58,54,45,.10), 0 2px 3px rgba(58,54,45,.18), 0 10px 22px -12px rgba(58,54,45,.35); PRESSED = inset 0 2px 6px rgba(58,54,45,.30) on a #cfcbc1 well face; DEBOSSED = inset 0 2px 5px rgba(58,54,45,.28), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) on #cfcbc1. Pushable buttons are three stacked layers: a darker static edge (background #c9c5ba, box-shadow 0 4px 6px rgba(58,54,45,.28)) under a raised front (translateY(-4px), transition transform .1s); the active button's front drops to translateY(0) with the PRESSED inset. Brushed metal (dial, slider thumbs): linear-gradient(180deg,#eceae4,#c8c5bc 55%,#b4b1a8) with inset top highlight and a repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0deg 2deg, rgba(58,54,45,.1) 2deg 4deg) knurl ring at 60% opacity mix-blend-multiply. Rocker toggles: a 46x26px debossed pill track with a 20px raised plastic thumb, ON = thumb right + a 5px amber pilot dot glowing in the track. Dimmer: a 12px debossed track, an amber gradient fill with a soft glow, a 24px knurled metal thumb riding the fill end. Fonts: Familjen Grotesk (600/700) for display and numerals, Karla (400/500/700) for body and labels (11px uppercase micro-labels tracked +0.08em), JetBrains Mono (500) only for meter digits. Icons: Iconify lucide. Amber is the ONLY chroma; no indigo, violet, teal or green anywhere. Pure CSS/SVG, no JavaScript; freeze all interactive states.

## Layout e Estrutura

### App shell
Root: a w-full min-h-dvh flex flex-col max-w-[440px] mx-auto column on the putty wall ground; NO phone frame, notch or status bar. Main content px-5 py-6 space-y-6. Top bar: sticky top-0 z-40, raised eggshell plastic with rounded-b-2xl, pt-5 px-5 pb-4: a 24px Familjen Grotesk bold house name ('Alder House') + a small debossed weather chip (a muted cloud icon + '9' with a degree sign in 13px semibold) on the left, a 40px round embossed avatar button on the right. Bottom bar: sticky bottom-0 z-40, raised plastic rounded-t-2xl px-6 pt-4 pb-[34px]: five slots (home active with a tiny amber pilot dot under it, grid, a 56px round convex center FAB with a plus icon raised -mt-8 above the bar, energy bolt, settings), icons 24px ink or muted.

### Room chips
A horizontal flex gap-3 row of snap-scroll chips (All, Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom): resting chips are RAISED eggshell plastic px-4 py-2 rounded-xl 14px bold muted; the active chip ('Living Room') is PRESSED into a debossed well face in ink text with a 6px amber pilot dot glowing beside the label.

### Thermostat dial hero
A raised plastic rounded-3xl p-6 card. Top-left: three 32px round mode buttons (snowflake raised muted, flame PRESSED with an amber glowing icon, 'A' raised). Centered: a 240px (w-60 h-60) circular brushed-aluminum dial: the metal gradient face with a soft drop shadow, an inset-1 knurl ring (repeating-conic ticks, opacity 60, mix-blend-multiply), then an inset-4 DEBOSSED circular inner face. Inside the inner face: an absolute inset-0 SVG (viewBox 0 0 100 100, rotated -90deg) with a track circle (r 44, stroke rgba(58,54,45,.1), width 4) and an amber arc circle (stroke #f5a11c, stroke-dasharray 276, stroke-dashoffset 180, round linecap, a soft amber drop-shadow filter), a small amber LED dot near the top, and a centered stack: a 64px Familjen Grotesk bold numeral '21.5' with a degree sign, leading-none, over a 12px bold uppercase tracked muted caption 'Heating to 22.0'.

### Scenes row
An 11px uppercase tracked muted micro-label 'Scenes', then a grid-cols-4 gap-3 of pushable buttons (Good Morning, Away, Movie Night, Sleep), each rounded-2xl with the three-layer construction: a darker edge layer under a raised eggshell front holding a 20px lucide icon over a 10px bold two-line label. The active scene ('Good Morning') has its front dropped flush onto the edge with the PRESSED inset, a well-tone face, ink label, and its icon in amber with a soft glow.

### Device grid
An 11px uppercase micro-label 'Devices', then a grid-cols-2 gap-3 of tactile cards, all RAISED rounded-3xl p-4 eggshell plastic. (1) Ceiling Lights, col-span-2: an 11x11 debossed icon well with an amber-glow blur behind an amber lightbulb icon, name in 15px Familjen semibold + 'Living Room, 70%' muted caption, a rocker toggle ON at the right; below, a dimmer: a 12px debossed track with an amber gradient fill to 70% and a 24px knurled metal thumb at the fill end. (2) Bookshelf Speaker: debossed icon well (speaker, ink), rocker ON, name + 'Playing' caption, then a debossed h-8 rounded-xl well holding a tiny 5-bar VU meter, three amber bars glowing + two hairline-grey bars. (3) Air Purifier: debossed icon well (wind, muted), rocker OFF (thumb left, no pilot), name + 'Living Room' caption, a debossed well reading 'STANDBY' in 10px bold uppercase muted. (4) Front Door, col-span-2 row: a round debossed key-plate well (key icon), name + 'Entry, auto-locks at 22:00' caption, and on the right a solid-ink pill (rounded-full px-3 py-1.5) with a lock icon + 'LOCKED' in 11px bold uppercase eggshell text.

### Energy meter
A DEBOSSED rounded-3xl p-4 inset screen (not a raised card): left, a 10px uppercase 'Today' micro-label, '6.4 kWh' in 22px JetBrains Mono ink, and a muted '12% less than yesterday' caption; right, a 120x44 SVG bar sparkline of seven rounded bars etched in rgba(58,54,45,.22) with the final (today) bar in amber, drawn SHORTER than yesterday's bar so the chart agrees with the caption.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Brushed-aluminum thermostat dial — A 240px circular rotary dial that reads as a physical machined knob: metal gradient face, knurled tick rim, debossed inner face, an SVG amber heating arc with rounded caps and a glow, a big display numeral.
Build a circular thermostat dial: a 240px round face filled with linear-gradient(180deg,#eceae4,#c8c5bc 55%,#b4b1a8), box-shadow inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.8), inset 0 -1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 8px 16px -4px rgba(58,54,45,.28); an inset-1 ring of repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0deg 2deg, rgba(58,54,45,.1) 2deg 4deg) at opacity .6 mix-blend-multiply for the knurl; an inset-4 debossed inner circle (#cfcbc1, inset 0 2px 5px rgba(58,54,45,.28), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7)); inside it an absolute -rotate-90 SVG (viewBox 0 0 100 100) with a muted track circle r=44 stroke-width 4 and an amber #f5a11c arc (stroke-dasharray 276, stroke-dashoffset 180, stroke-linecap round, drop-shadow glow), plus a small amber LED dot; centered on top, a 64px display numeral and a small uppercase tracked status caption.

### Rocker toggle — A real physical two-position toggle: a raised plastic thumb inside a debossed pill track, with an amber pilot dot when on.
Make a 46x26px rounded-full toggle track in #cfcbc1 with inset 0 2px 5px rgba(58,54,45,.28), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7). Inside, a 20px round thumb in #f3f1ea with inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85), inset 0 -2px 3px rgba(58,54,45,.10), 0 2px 3px rgba(58,54,45,.25), parked 3px from the right edge when ON and 3px from the left when OFF. When ON, add a 5px amber #f5a11c pilot dot with a 5px glow on the vacated side of the track. No JS; freeze each toggle in its state.

### Three-layer pushable scene button — A scene button built like a physical key: a darker static bottom edge under a raised front that visibly drops flush when the scene is active.
Construct each scene button from stacked layers sharing one border-radius (16px): an absolute-inset 'edge' layer in #c9c5ba with box-shadow 0 4px 6px rgba(58,54,45,.28), and a relative 'front' layer in #f3f1ea translated up 4px, holding a centered 20px icon and a 10px bold two-line label. The ACTIVE button's front sits at translateY(0) with inset 0 2px 6px rgba(58,54,45,.30) and a #cfcbc1 face, its icon switched to amber with a soft glow, so it reads as pressed in and latched.

### Knurled-thumb dimmer slider — A dimmer that reads as hardware: a debossed track, a glowing amber fill, and a small brushed-metal thumb with the dial's knurl finish.
Build a dimmer: a 12px tall rounded-full track in #cfcbc1 with the debossed inset recipe; an absolute fill from the left in linear-gradient(180deg,#ffbf52,#f5a11c) with a 6px amber glow, width set to the level (70%); a 24px round thumb centered on the fill end in the brushed-metal gradient (linear-gradient(180deg,#eceae4,#c8c5bc 55%,#b4b1a8)) with inset highlights and a 3px 6px drop shadow. Label the level in the card caption ('70%') so the control and copy agree.

### Debossed energy-meter screen — An inset LCD-like panel: mono digits and a tiny etched bar sparkline living IN the surface instead of on a raised card.
Make the energy strip a debossed panel: #cfcbc1 face, rounded-3xl, inset 0 2px 5px rgba(58,54,45,.28), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7). Left column: a 10px bold uppercase tracked muted label, the reading in 22px JetBrains Mono ink, a 12px muted delta caption. Right: an inline SVG (viewBox 0 0 120 44) of seven 12px-wide rounded bars, six etched in rgba(58,54,45,.22) and the last in amber #f5a11c, its height consistent with the delta caption.

A warm putty-stone wall, matte eggshell-plastic control faces, debossed wells and inset screens, a brushed-aluminum dial with a knurled ring, and ONE amber glow accent that reads as warm light actually being on.
